label: Siemens XA60 ReproIn session (68 DICOM files)
description: Public-domain 3 T Siemens XA60 session with ReproIn protocol names: T1w, rest and task BOLD, spin-echo and gradient-echo field maps, and scouts. The author's own scan, shared with consent; DICOM headers are not anonymized.
expectedResult: Download a BIDS dataset at crlab/AgingBrain with sub-ro ses-1 anat, func and fmap NIfTI and sidecars, the session taken from the scout and field maps linked by B0FieldIdentifier/B0FieldSource; view the T1w image.

label: T1 MRI without ReproIn naming (120 DICOM slices)
description: Public NiiVue VS-SEG-001 Siemens Avanto T1 series. Its protocol is not ReproIn-named, so the post-pass rescues it from Unknown/.
expectedResult: Download a BIDS dataset with sub-vsseg001 anat/T1w NIfTI, sidecar and scans.tsv, and view the T1 image.
